mcat_description.short: Prefabricated aluminium structural frameworks and assemblies, including solar panel mounting structures, canopies, roofing trusses, space frames, and modular building frames, fabricated from extruded or rolled aluminium alloy sections and sold as complete structural systems or components.
mcat_description.long: Aluminium structures encompass a wide range of prefabricated and custom-fabricated structural systems made from aluminium alloy extrusions, sections, and profiles — including solar panel mounting structures (monorail and multi-rail), canopy and pergola frames, roofing trusses, space frames, curtain wall sub-frames, and modular building skeletons. In the Indian B2B market, the dominant alloy grades are 6061 and 6063 (T5/T6 temper), which offer the optimal balance of extrudability, structural strength, and corrosion resistance for outdoor and construction applications. Fabricated structures are typically anodised or powder-coated for weather protection and are designed to comply with IS:875 wind load standards and the National Building Code of India. Buyers range from solar EPC contractors and rooftop solar installers to construction contractors, architects, and industrial shed fabricators.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, 'Aluminium Structure' is a broad umbrella term covering prefabricated and custom-fabricated structural systems made from aluminium alloy extrusions and sections. The solar panel mounting structure sub-segment — particularly aluminium monorail and multi-rail systems — is the most commercially active product type, driven by India's rapid rooftop solar expansion under MNRE schemes. The dominant alloy grade for structural and solar applications is Aluminium 6063 T6, valued for its extrudability, corrosion resistance, and structural strength; 6061 T6 is used for higher-load applications. BIS standards IS 736 (wrought aluminium sheets for general engineering) and IS 737 (high-strength structural aluminium sheets) govern material quality, with the 2023/2025 QCO making BIS certification mandatory for aluminium products sold in India. Solar mounting structures are additionally evaluated against MNRE guidelines and wind load compliance per IS:875. Key manufacturing hubs for aluminium solar structures include Rajkot (Gujarat), Chennai (Tamil Nadu), and Delhi NCR. The market spans residential rooftop solar (1–10 kW), commercial rooftop (10 kW–1 MW), and utility-scale ground-mounted systems. Non-solar aluminium structures (canopies, pergolas, modular frames, curtain wall sub-frames) serve construction, industrial, and architectural buyers and are typically custom-fabricated to project specifications.
